s0101.literal: On jiayin day the Luan River at Shangdu was dredged.
s0101.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Luan River at Shangdu was dredged.

s0102.literal: On yimao day Prince Changtong's five-shipul silk was distributed to Prince Tash Temür.
s0102.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Changtong's five-shipul silk was distributed to Prince Tash Temür.

s0103.literal: Ganzhou relay households hidden by Buddhist monks, tlughtu, and others were ordered returned to corvée according to regulation.
s0103.idiomatic: Ganzhou relay households hidden by Buddhist monks, tlughtu, and others were ordered returned to corvée according to regulation.

s0104.literal: An edict declared: officials within and without who lacked public fields were granted salary rice in measured amounts; at Shangdu, Gansu, Karakorum, and other places that were not rice-producing regions, only the price was given.
s0104.idiomatic: An edict declared: officials within and without who lacked public fields were granted salary rice in measured amounts; at Shangdu, Gansu, Karakorum, and other places that were not rice-producing regions, only the price was given.

s0105.literal: Prince Babusha's following was forbidden to hunt at Panyang and other places, disturbing the people.
s0105.idiomatic: Prince Babusha's following was forbidden to hunt at Panyang and other places, disturbing the people.

s0106.literal: An edict declared: among imperial guard soldiers, apart from sons of officials who had previously received memorial approval to remain, all the rest were dismissed.
s0106.idiomatic: An edict declared: among imperial guard soldiers, apart from sons of officials who had previously received memorial approval to remain, all the rest were dismissed.

s0107.literal: Princes and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to beat prefecture and county officials on their own authority; violators' princely establishment officials were punished.
s0107.idiomatic: Princes and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to beat prefecture and county officials on their own authority; violators' princely establishment officials were punished.

s0108.literal: The Karakorum Pacification Commission Commander-in-Chief Headquarters was established; Hulachu, by remote appointment left vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief.
s0108.idiomatic: The Karakorum pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters was established; Hulachu, by remote appointment left vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief.

s0109.literal: Prince Nahu'li was granted one thousand ingots of notes and thirty bolts of silks.
s0109.idiomatic: Prince Nahu'li was granted 1,000 ingots of notes and 30 bolts of silks.

s0110.literal: Jining, Dongchang, Jinan, Panyang, and Yidu suffered insects eating the wheat;
s0110.idiomatic: Jining, Dongchang, Jinan, Panyang, and Yidu suffered insects eating the wheat;

s0111.literal: Taiyuan, Longxing, Nankang, Yuan, Rui, and Fu routes and Gaotang and Nanfeng prefectures suffered famine; fifty-five thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced price in relief;
s0111.idiomatic: Taiyuan, Longxing, Nankang, Yuan, Rui, and Fu routes and Gaotang and Nanfeng prefectures suffered famine; 55,000 shi of grain were sold at reduced price in relief;

s0112.literal: Dongping, Yidu, and Jinan routes suffered locusts;
s0112.idiomatic: Dongping, Yidu, and Jinan routes suffered locusts;

s0114.literal: Intercalary fifth month, wuwu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
s0114.idiomatic: Intercalary fifth month, wuwu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

s0115.literal: Because Yanuo Temür, Kuokuochu, and Huangwumu died in the army, their families were granted notes in varying amounts.
s0115.idiomatic: Because Yanuo Temür, Kuokuochu, and Huangwumu died in the army, their families were granted notes in varying amounts.

s0116.literal: On renxu day an edict forbade offenses against the forest and temple at Qufu.
s0116.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict forbade offenses against the forest and temple at Qufu.

s0117.literal: On dingmao day fifteen routes including Pingjiang suffered famine among the people; three hundred fifty-four thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced price in relief.
s0117.idiomatic: On dingmao day 15 routes including Pingjiang suffered famine among the people; 354,000 shi of grain were sold at reduced price in relief.

s0118.literal: On wuchen day the moon encroached upon Heart.
s0118.idiomatic: On wuchen day the moon encroached upon Heart.

s0119.literal: On jisi day, because princes Boluo and Zhentong had merit in suppressing bandits, they were summoned to the capital.
s0119.idiomatic: On jisi day, because princes Boluo and Zhentong had merit in suppressing bandits, they were summoned to the capital.

s0121.literal: On gengchen day Yesudai'er, grand councillor of the Yunnan branch secretariat, came to court and presented five hundred taels of gold taken from the army as tribute.
s0121.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yesudai'er, grand councillor of the Yunnan branch secretariat, came to court and presented 500 taels of gold taken from the army as tribute.

s0122.literal: The Emperor said: "This gold was obtained by your risking death in battle.
s0122.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This gold was obtained by your risking death in battle.

s0123.literal: " He was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
s0123.idiomatic: He was granted 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0124.literal: On dingchou day princes, imperial sons-in-law, and others were forbidden to send slaves as substitutes among northern campaign armies — offenders were punished.
s0124.idiomatic: On dingchou day princes, imperial sons-in-law, and others were forbidden to send slaves as substitutes among northern campaign armies — offenders were punished.

s0125.literal: On xinsi day an edict declared that Buddhist monks and commoners alike should share corvée duties.
s0125.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict declared that Buddhist monks and commoners alike should share corvée duties.

s0126.literal: On guiwei day pacification envoys from each circuit said: "Households afflicted by disaster last year who have not yet received relief should have their corvée remitted.
s0126.idiomatic: On guiwei day pacification envoys from each circuit said, "Households afflicted by disaster last year who have not yet received relief should have their corvée remitted.

s0128.literal: Dong Shixuan, right vice chancellor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was ordered to dispatch confiscated property of Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan to the capital; overseas merchant vessels not yet returned, when they arrived, were to be confiscated according to regulation.
s0128.idiomatic: Dong Shixuan, right vice chancellor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was ordered to dispatch confiscated property of Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan to the capital; overseas merchant vessels not yet returned, when they arrived, were to be confiscated according to regulation.

s0129.literal: Hesan, grand councillor of the Gansu branch secretariat, and others embezzled more than one hundred sixty-three thousand ingots of official funds and more than five thousand salt certificates; provincial and censorate officials were ordered to recover them.
s0129.idiomatic: Hesan, grand councillor of the Gansu branch secretariat, and others embezzled more than 163,000 ingots of official funds and more than 5,000 salt certificates; provincial and censorate officials were ordered to recover them.

s0130.literal: An edict declared that Shangdu Route, Yingchang Prefecture, Yiqiliesi, Karakorum, and other places should observe the inner-circuit wine prohibition.
s0130.idiomatic: An edict declared that Shangdu Route, Yingchang Prefecture, Yiqiliesi, Karakorum, and other places should observe the inner-circuit wine prohibition.

s0131.literal: On bingxu day the Garrison-Farm Intendant Office was abolished.
s0131.idiomatic: On bingxu day the garrison-farm intendant office was abolished.

s0132.literal: Insects ate the wheat in Kaifeng County, Bianliang.
s0132.idiomatic: Insects ate the wheat in Kaifeng County, Bianliang.

s0133.literal: Sixth month, jichou day: censorate officials said: "Gua and Sha, two prefectures, have from old been important frontier garrison places; now the great army is stationed at Ganzhou, making officials and commoners live outside the border — this is not fitting.
s0133.idiomatic: Sixth month, jichou day: censorate officials said, "Gua and Sha, two prefectures, have from old been important frontier garrison places; now the great army is stationed at Ganzhou, making officials and commoners live outside the border — this is not fitting.

s0134.literal: We ask that ten thousand Mongol troops be divided to garrison strategic passes and garrison farms established to supply the army — this would be convenient.
s0134.idiomatic: We ask that 10,000 Mongol troops be divided to garrison strategic passes and garrison farms established to supply the army — this would be convenient.

s0136.literal: The Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished and the Sichuan Branch Secretariat established; Toghto, grand councillor of the Yunnan branch secretariat, and Cheng Pengfei, deliberating grand councillor of the Huguang branch secretariat, were both made grand councillors.
s0136.idiomatic: The Sichuan pacification commission was abolished and the Sichuan branch secretariat established; Toghto, grand councillor of the Yunnan branch secretariat, and Cheng Pengfei, deliberating grand councillor of the Huguang branch secretariat, were both made grand councillors.

s0137.literal: On renchen day Wugang Route suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced price in relief.
s0137.idiomatic: On renchen day Wugang Route suffered famine; 10,000 shi of grain were sold at reduced price in relief.

s0138.literal: Qincha thousand-households and other impoverished persons were granted more than thirty-seven thousand eight hundred ingots of notes.
s0138.idiomatic: Qincha thousand-households and other impoverished persons were granted more than 37,800 ingots of notes.

s0139.literal: On guisi day the rebel Xiong Cuo came to submit.
s0139.idiomatic: On guisi day the rebel Xiong Cuo came to submit.

s0140.literal: On yiwei day, because Yiqibuxie had been pacified, two thousand tammaq troops were left to suppress the Ayong rebel barbarians; the remainder were all sent home.
s0140.idiomatic: On yiwei day, because Yiqibuxie had been pacified, 2,000 tammaq troops were left to suppress the Ayong rebel barbarians; the remainder were all sent home.

s0141.literal: On gengzi day Fahur al-Din, pacification commissioner of the Western Capital Circuit, sold more than two thousand five hundred jin of seser to the government for more than eleven thousand nine hundred ingots of notes.
s0141.idiomatic: On gengzi day Fahur al-Din, pacification commissioner of the Western Capital Circuit, sold more than 2,500 jin of seser to the government for more than 11,900 ingots of notes.

s0142.literal: An order declared: apart from what was used for the imperial couch, all that remained unused should be fully returned.
s0142.idiomatic: An order declared: apart from what was used for the imperial couch, all that remained unused should be fully returned.

s0143.literal: Abo and Ahutai were ordered to put in order military affairs west of the river.
s0143.idiomatic: Abo and Ahutai were ordered to put in order military affairs west of the river.

s0144.literal: On guimao day an edict declared: whenever sons of military officials reached twenty years of age, like sons of civilian officials they should serve rotation watch duty for one year before being permitted to inherit office — myriarchs at the privy council, chiliarchs at the branch secretariat, and centurions at their own myriarch's office.
s0144.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict declared: whenever sons of military officials reached 20 years of age, like sons of civilian officials they should serve rotation watch duty for one year before being permitted to inherit office — myriarchs at the privy council, chiliarchs at the branch secretariat, and centurions at their own myriarch's office.

s0145.literal: On yisi day branch secretariat provincial commissioners were abolished.
s0145.idiomatic: On yisi day branch secretariat provincial commissioners were abolished.

s0146.literal: Western Zhejiang suffered prolonged rain; one hundred forty thousand people suffered famine and were given one month's relief grain; this year's summer tax and each household's wine and vinegar levies were also remitted.
s0146.idiomatic: Western Zhejiang suffered prolonged rain; 140,000 people suffered famine and were given one month's relief grain; this year's summer tax and each household's wine and vinegar levies were also remitted.

s0147.literal: The Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to repair the Ahe Tan and Quyou Hao canals to open grain transport.
s0147.idiomatic: The Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to repair the Ahe Tan and Quyou Hao canals to open grain transport.

s0149.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinyou day: Changde Route suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced price in relief.
s0149.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, xinyou day: Changde Route suffered famine; 10,000 shi of grain were sold at reduced price in relief.

s0150.literal: On renxu day censorate officials said: "Former Hejian Route darughachi Husaiyin and transport commissioner Shujia Deshou were both dismissed for corruption.
s0150.idiomatic: On renxu day censorate officials said, "Former Hejian Route darughachi Husaiyin and transport commissioner Shujia Deshou were both dismissed for corruption.

s0151.literal: Now Husaiyin, for presenting hawks and hunting dogs, has again been appointed darughachi of Daning Route;
s0151.idiomatic: Now Husaiyin, for presenting hawks and hunting dogs, has again been appointed darughachi of Daning Route;

s0152.literal: Shujia Deshou, because Diemishi falsely memorialized that he had been slandered, has again been appointed prefect of Funing;
s0152.idiomatic: Shujia Deshou, because Diemishi falsely memorialized that he had been slandered, has again been appointed prefect of Funing;

s0153.literal: both should be corrected and not reappointed, to restrain the corrupt and greedy.
s0153.idiomatic: both should be corrected and not reappointed, to restrain the corrupt and greedy.

s0155.literal: Buddhist monks were forbidden to use construction of temples as a pretext, carrying princes' orders and abusing relay transport to disturb the people.
s0155.idiomatic: Buddhist monks were forbidden to use construction of temples as a pretext, carrying princes' orders and abusing relay transport to disturb the people.

s0157.literal: On bingyin day Dalaqan Halaqsun was made right chancellor of the central secretariat and director of privy council affairs.
s0157.idiomatic: On bingyin day Dalaqan Halaqsun was made right chancellor of the central secretariat and director of privy council affairs.

s0158.literal: On wuyin day Jupiter encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0158.idiomatic: On wuyin day Jupiter encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0159.literal: On bingzi day twelve relay tickets were granted to the Sichuan branch secretariat.
s0159.idiomatic: On bingzi day 12 relay tickets were granted to the Sichuan branch secretariat.

s0160.literal: An edict declared that senior venerable ministers of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and Hanlin were to participate in deliberating court affairs; all others below rank three who were seventy years of age should each be promoted one grade in honorary rank and retire.
s0160.idiomatic: An edict declared that senior venerable ministers of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and Hanlin were to participate in deliberating court affairs; all others below rank three who were 70 years of age should each be promoted one grade in honorary rank and retire.

s0161.literal: The Karakorum Military and Horse Office was established; the Liaodong Pacification Commission was abolished.
s0161.idiomatic: The Karakorum military and horse office was established; the Liaodong pacification commission was abolished.

s0162.literal: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said: "Datong tax revenues, which by imperial order were granted to wet nurse Yang, have been over-exacted by her household beyond the proper amount, greatly disturbing the people.
s0162.idiomatic: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said, "Datong tax revenues, which by imperial order were granted to wet nurse Yang, have been over-exacted by her household beyond the proper amount, greatly disturbing the people.

s0163.literal: " An order granted five hundred ingots of notes; the tax revenues were to be paid to the government according to regulation.
s0163.idiomatic: An order granted 500 ingots of notes; the tax revenues were to be paid to the government according to regulation.

s0164.literal: Censorate officials said: "In Hunan, those delivering one hundred shi of grain furnished one relay horse; in the Guang-Hai region the land is narrow and deliveries fall short of one hundred shi, yet the same requirement applied — so the government assisted their shortfall with salt certificates.
s0164.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "In Hunan, those delivering 100 shi of grain furnished one relay horse; in the Guang-Hai region the land is narrow and deliveries fell short of 100 shi, yet the same requirement applied — so the government assisted their shortfall with salt certificates.

s0165.literal: For each horse, north of Guizhou seventeen salt certificates were given, south of it twenty.
s0165.idiomatic: For each horse, north of Guizhou 17 salt certificates were given, south of it 20.

s0166.literal: Recently the salt monopoly intendant office was established and official prices were raised by three-fifths; where twenty certificates were formerly given, seventeen ingots of notes should now be given, and where seventeen were given, fifteen ingots.
s0166.idiomatic: Recently the salt monopoly intendant office was established and official prices were raised by three-fifths; where 20 certificates were formerly given, 17 ingots of notes should now be given, and where 17 were given, 15 ingots.

s0168.literal: The Jiangnan White Cloud Sect metropolitan registry was abolished; its fields were ordered to pay rent according to regulation.
s0168.idiomatic: The Jiangnan White Cloud Sect metropolitan registry was abolished; its fields were ordered to pay rent according to regulation.

s0169.literal: Duwa, Chapar, Meyit Temür, and others dispatched envoys requesting a ceasefire; the Emperor ordered the Prince of Anxi to restrain his soldiers, arrange relay stations, and await their arrival.
s0169.idiomatic: Duwa, Chapar, Meyit Temür, and others dispatched envoys requesting a ceasefire; the Emperor ordered the Prince of Anxi to restrain his soldiers, arrange relay stations, and await their arrival.

s0170.literal: On wuyin day princes Nulun, Bayan, and Yebogan and others were granted ninety thousand ingots of notes; the general-manager offices established by princes were abolished.
s0170.idiomatic: On wuyin day princes Nulun, Bayan, and Yebogan and others were granted 90,000 ingots of notes; the general-manager offices established by princes were abolished.

s0171.literal: The rebel Man'i submitted, presenting five hundred taels of gold, two hundred boys and girls, and horses, cattle, and sheep; all were declined.
s0171.idiomatic: The rebel Man'i submitted, presenting 500 taels of gold, 200 boys and girls, and horses, cattle, and sheep; all were declined.

s0172.literal: On jimao day the moon encroached upon Well.
s0172.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon encroached upon Well.

s0173.literal: On yiyou day Mars encroached upon Room.
s0173.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mars encroached upon Room.

s0174.literal: The followings of princes Qu'erlu and others were granted notes and silks in varying amounts.
s0174.idiomatic: The followings of princes Qu'erlu and others were granted notes and silks in varying amounts.

s0175.literal: Eighth month, jichou day: the Jiangnan garrison-farm intendant office originally under the Protect the State and Benevolent King Temple was abolished; twenty thousand shi of grain were granted to impoverished commoners under the Prince of Anxi.
s0175.idiomatic: Eighth month, jichou day: the Jiangnan garrison-farm intendant office originally under the Protect the State and Benevolent King Temple was abolished; 20,000 shi of grain were granted to impoverished commoners under the Prince of Anxi.

s0176.literal: On xinmao day an earthquake struck at night; Pingyang and Taiyuan suffered especially severely — villages and forts shifted, the ground split into channels, and people crushed to death were beyond counting; envoys were dispatched by separate routes to give relief amounting to more than ninety-six thousand five hundred ingots of notes; this year's corvée and taxes in Taiyuan and Pingyang were also remitted, and mountains, marshes, rivers, and lakes were opened for the people to gather and hunt.
s0176.idiomatic: On xinmao day an earthquake struck at night; Pingyang and Taiyuan suffered especially severely — villages and forts shifted, the ground split into channels, and people crushed to death were beyond counting; envoys were dispatched by separate routes to give relief amounting to more than 96,500 ingots of notes; this year's corvée and taxes in Taiyuan and Pingyang were also remitted, and mountains, marshes, rivers, and lakes were opened for the people to gather and hunt.

s0177.literal: On guisi day Venus encroached upon Establishing Star.
s0177.idiomatic: On guisi day Venus encroached upon Establishing Star.

s0178.literal: Yueli Buhua was leading Onggir troops to Yunnan but died on the road; his son Puerye replaced him.
s0178.idiomatic: Yueli Buhua was leading Onggir troops to Yunnan but died on the road; his son Puerye replaced him.

s0179.literal: On jiawu day Mars encroached upon Eastern Winnowing, and the moon encroached upon Niulang.
s0179.idiomatic: On jiawu day Mars encroached upon Eastern Winnowing, and the moon encroached upon Niulang.

s0180.literal: On gengzi day central secretariat officials said: "Fahur al-Din transported grain for the Karakorum army; his arrears amount to more than two hundred fifty thousand shi; recently surveillance censors also reported his embezzling more than one hundred thirty thousand ingots of official funds.
s0180.idiomatic: On gengzi day central secretariat officials said, "Fahur al-Din transported grain for the Karakorum army; his arrears amount to more than 250,000 shi; recently surveillance censors also reported his embezzling more than 130,000 ingots of official funds.

s0181.literal: We deliberated: dispatch officials to recover it; if insufficient, confiscate his property.
s0181.idiomatic: We deliberated: dispatch officials to recover it; if insufficient, confiscate his property.

s0183.literal: On yisi day Jupiter encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0183.idiomatic: On yisi day Jupiter encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0184.literal: On gengxu day the king of Burma dispatched envoys presenting four trained elephants.
s0184.idiomatic: On gengxu day the king of Burma dispatched envoys presenting four trained elephants.

s0185.literal: On xinhai day Mars encroached upon Heavenly River.
s0185.idiomatic: On xinhai day Mars encroached upon Heavenly River.

s0186.literal: The followings of Prince Toqtemur's son Yesian Boqie and others were granted more than six thousand nine hundred ingots of notes.
s0186.idiomatic: The followings of Prince Toqtemur's son Yesian Boqie and others were granted more than 6,900 ingots of notes.

s0187.literal: Ninth month, wuwu day: the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0187.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu day: the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0188.literal: On bingyin day Venus appeared in daylight.
s0188.idiomatic: On bingyin day Venus appeared in daylight.

s0189.literal: Because of the earthquakes at Taiyuan and Pingyang, princes Ajiji and Xiaoxue and their followings were forbidden to disturb the people; half of Taiyuan's annual horse fodder levy was also remitted.
s0189.idiomatic: Because of the earthquakes at Taiyuan and Pingyang, princes Ajiji and Xiaoxue and their followings were forbidden to disturb the people; half of Taiyuan's annual horse fodder levy was also remitted.

s0190.literal: Minister of Punishments Taqar and Hanlin awaiting-edict drafter Wang Yue were dispatched as envoys to Koryo, because that state's chancellor Wu Qi monopolized power, to summon him to court for judgment.
s0190.idiomatic: Minister of punishments Taqar and Hanlin awaiting-edict drafter Wang Yue were dispatched as envoys to Koryo, because that state's chancellor Wu Qi monopolized power, to summon him to court for judgment.

s0191.literal: On xinwei day Mars encroached upon Southern Dipper.
s0191.idiomatic: On xinwei day Mars encroached upon Southern Dipper.

s0192.literal: An edict directed all offices to give relief to Pingyang and Taiyuan.
s0192.idiomatic: An edict directed all offices to give relief to Pingyang and Taiyuan.

s0193.literal: On jiaxu day the moon encroached upon Eastern Well.
s0193.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon encroached upon Eastern Well.

s0194.literal: On yihai day Venus encroached upon Southern Dipper.
s0194.idiomatic: On yihai day Venus encroached upon Southern Dipper.

s0195.literal: On bingzi day Buddhist officials who had wives were dismissed.
s0195.idiomatic: On bingzi day Buddhist officials who had wives were dismissed.

s0196.literal: On renwu day Mercury encroached upon Establishing Star.
s0196.idiomatic: On renwu day Mercury encroached upon Establishing Star.

s0197.literal: Mubarak Shah was restored as grand councillor.
s0197.idiomatic: Mubarak Shah was restored as grand councillor.

s0198.literal: Winter, tenth month, dinghai day: Venus passed through heaven.
s0198.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, dinghai day: Venus passed through heaven.

s0199.literal: Censorate officials impeached and reported that Ali, grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, acted unlawfully; the Emperor said: "Ali is one whom We trust; for censorate officials to speak of him repeatedly is not the way to encourage great ministers.
s0199.idiomatic: Censorate officials impeached and reported that Ali, grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, acted unlawfully; the Emperor said, "Ali is one whom We trust; for censorate officials to speak of him repeatedly is not the way to encourage great ministers.

s0200.literal: If anyone speaks of this hereafter, We shall not forgive it.
s0200.idiomatic: If anyone speaks of this hereafter, We shall not forgive it.
